verifications.note: Page read in full. Names the Vytegra to Pudozh pipeline and says work is starting.

fills.researcher_notes: RBC of April 2024 says a contractor registered an excavator to begin work on the Vytegra to Pudozh offtake pipeline. The January 2025 article says the pipe on this last stage will still be laid. Construction is the right status for now.
Neither the RBC page nor the January 2025 article gives an expected start-up year. The sheet value of 2025 stays. No wiki citation states this value; not searched this pass.

The only capacity found is 743 million cubic meters a year in a government list, and it covers the whole build from Kirillov to Pudozh. That is not a figure for this stage. The sheet value matches that total.
No cited page names an operator. The sheet cell holds the name in Russian spelling and should be put in the ownership team style, Gazprom PJSC, by a person.
No cited page names the legal owner of this pipeline. The pages say the work is under a Gazprom program with the Vologda region. The sheet owner stays.
